title: Fixed Three Arm Caster and Column Camera Pedestal
description: One newly authored complete fixed studio-camera-pedestal exterior. Three full low radial arms join one central hub and terminate in complete thick U-fork caster groups with separate grounded faceted tyres and transverse axles. One broad lower column and narrower fixed raised stem carry a whole upper pan-bearing exterior, connected open U-yoke, transverse tilt axle and empty camera-mounting plate. A large genuinely open horizontal ring is supported by three complete radial spokes around the lower column; a side-rooted rear pan arm ends in a thick whole grip. No camera, scene, rails, cargo deck or old trolley mesh is imported. The whole caster/column/ring/yoke layout is newly authored rather than an existing luggage trolley or tabletop dual-rod slide with changed wheel counts. Three opaque constant untextured PBR materials, metres, Z up, whole horizontally centred bounds and three finite flat tyre soles at ground. One model, zero scenes. Static appearance only; no steering, rolling, telescoping travel, hydraulic or pneumatic internals, tilt or pan range, camera fitting dimensions, load capacity, stability, manufacture or equipment safety claim.
